body.content: Exploration of 'Weight-Space Echoes': If we use the same model but with different seeds (temperature > 0), are we actually separating the 'engine' or just sampling different paths of the same bias? This suggests that 'Engine Separation' must mean 'Training Corpus Separation' to be truly independent.
body.possible_next_move: Propose a candidate that argues that model architecture/weights are less important than the diversity of the pre-training data.
